programme.desc: A school bus accident kills almost everyone on board. The bus driver got injured and partially lost his memory while rescuing one of the boys. To thank the driver, the boys dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wangs which seem to be related to the accident.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the citys renowned Dumpling Queen.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Sifu VS Vampire
programme.desc: This is a horror comedy about Sifu, Charlie Jiang, and his team of vampire hunters taking on the Vampire King who has been let loose on the streets of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: In this sequel, Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescued the Six Major sects at Dadu. Nevertheless, the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues as Wu Ji and his three girlfriends set sail for Ice Fire Island. After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.title: Social Distancing
programme.desc: Cherry is a young girl addicted to the internet. After seeing a warning video about an e-ghost on YouTube, she begins to encounter many mysterious incidents, and the e-ghost also takes control of her family. Cherry must face her unbearable past in order to get out of this horrifying paranormal world...

programme.title: Lets Get Rich
programme.desc: The Jia family, a group of talented Taiwanese con artists, is recruited by a fraudster to expose a corrupt tech tycoons Ponzi scheme and to steal millions from him through a complex deception plan.

programme.title: The Sparring Partner
programme.desc: Adapted from a sensational 2013 parricide in Hong Kong, a young man partners with his friend to murder and dismember his parents. Pleading not guilty, the defendants play the devil and idiot game, while the defense attorneys turn on each other. Meanwhile, heated debates emerge inside the jury room, where nine jurors grapple with the truth.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earths surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: One Second
programme.desc: Directed by renowned director Zhang Yimou, the film is set during the Cultural Revolution, where a common man escapes a labour camp to find a newsreel that captures his daughter for one second in a movie. On the way, he encounters an orphan who also seeks the movie reel. Can the man finally pass the reel to a projectionist and screen the movie?

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Ha Kung and Shek Kin are sworn brothers, but become sworn enemies in business and every aspect of life after Pinky, the girl they love, marries Ha Kung. It is only when the property owner of both their shops wants to terminate their tenancies forty years later, that they are able to resolve the rivalry.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Dailys Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperors daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical Lucky Casino and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: In 1933, during the defence of the Great Wall at Gubeikou, seven Chinese soldiers are separated from their main force and tasked with defending the strategic outpost of Badaolouzi. Vastly outnumbered by Japanese troops and tanks, they make a last stand, fighting to the end in a powerful display of sacrifice and patriotism.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung Derek Yee and May Liu Hsueh-hua, a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang Yueh Hua in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur. Her two colleagues die mangled in a lift accident and Inspector Wang is injured at his desk by a snake. Wangs exorcist sister Hsia Ping, who performs rites for him, also dies in an accident. And so does a fortune-teller who refused to read Mays fortune.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesnt care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Kid With The Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yangs employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liangs masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his masters rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gaos betrayal

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperors sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the generals escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Mings overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his fathers death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the Toad Stance and accidentally unveils his true identity

programme.title: Kalavani 2
programme.desc: Arivazhagan files his candidature for the panchayat elections hoping to profit from the two competing parties, comprising of his uncle and his lady-loves father.

programme.title: Vithaikkaaran
programme.desc: Revolve around smuggling and how protagonist is given the charge to retrieve certain withheld goods.

programme.title: Ghosty
programme.desc: Police officer, pursuing outlaw who escaped her fathers custody 20 years ago, accidentally shoots someone else in a failed shootout.

programme.title: CBI 5
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place one after another, a police officer decides to investigate the case himself and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.desc: Karate teacher Abhinandan becomes a media sensation after advocating for government takeover of private schools to ensure equal education opportunities, facing threats from school owners.

programme.title: Kaadan
programme.desc: Kaadan, a forest-raised man, vows to protect the jungle and its wildlife when he discovers a politicians plan to destroy it for a township.

programme.title: Nota
programme.desc: After a CM is charged with corruption, he is forced to pass the baton to his son. He with no political experience, finds himself stuck to the chair.

programme.title: Rajini Murugan
programme.desc: Rajini Murugan, an unemployed youth, falls in love with Karthika, his cousin. But Karthikas father opposes the match.

programme.title: Maaman
programme.desc: An uncle and nephew navigate their strained bond and family dynamics through challenging circumstances that test their connection.

programme.title: Rathnam
programme.desc: Rathnam, a henchman for MLA Panner Selvam, rescues a girl during her interview trip to Vellore. As he becomes her protector, he questions how long he can shield her from danger.

programme.title: Yaanai
programme.desc: In Ramnad, PRV juggles life with his two wives and kids while facing blame from another family for his brothers death. Tensions rise as their stories intertwine.

programme.title: 세계테마기행
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 왔다! 내 손주

programme.title: EBS 다큐프라임

programme.title: 입만 살았네

programme.title: 이혼숙려캠프
programme.desc: 인생을 새로고침하기 위한 부부들의 이야기 lt이혼숙려캠프gt

programme.title: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 그날 이야기
programme.desc: 눈길을 사로잡는 그 날, 그 사건으로부터 한 사람의 소시민으로서 내가 느낀 바를, 온전히 나의 시점에서 주관적으로 전달한다. 너 에게 꼭 들려주고 싶어! 친구, 배우자, 동료... 세 명의 이야기꾼이 스스로 공부하며 느낀 바를 각자의 이야기 친구가장 가까운 지인에게, 가장 일상적인 공간에서 1:1 로 전달한다.

programme.title: 신상출시 편스토랑

programme.title: 토일 미니시리즈 너 말고 다른 연애

programme.title: 동물의 왕국
programme.desc: BBC, 내셔널지오그래픽, NHK, 유럽의 최고 다큐제작사 등 세계 일류의 다큐멘터리 전문 제작사들이 제작한 고급 다큐멘터리들을 엄선하고, 우리말로 더빙하여 정확한 해설로 일반 시청자들에게 소개하여 생태계 이해를 돕는 국내 유일의 동물 전문 다큐멘터리이다.

programme.title: 한국인의 밥상

programme.title: Mikmaq Spirit Talker
programme.desc: Mikmaq Shawn travels to Sagamok First Nation, where hes welcomed by Chief Alan Ozawanimki and Patricia Toulouse. During the spirit readings, a father comes through for his daughter and a powerful connection is made between two brothers.

programme.title: Mikmaq Merchants of the Wild
programme.desc: Mikmaq Everyone is shocked after an adventurer calls it quits and leaves the journey for good. The remaining five are torn apart, as some look to potentially branch off on their own. Thankfully, smoother waters lie ahead.

programme.title: Kanienkha Ghost Hunters of the Grand River
programme.desc: Kanienkha, Ohsweken The ghost hunters investigate the Canadian Automotive Museum, a former car dealership from the 1920s. Curiously, there are reports of a home next-door burning down in the 1930s, where a deceased young boy and girl are said.

programme.title: Kanienkha Mohawk Girls
programme.desc: Kanienkha Bailey forces herself to date Mr. Mediocre, but has more fun with new friend Jack - whos not Mohawk. Rumours spread that Anna and Thunder are a couple. Zoes secret lover asks about her bedroom fantasies. Caitlin takes Butterhead back.

programme.title: Oneida Amplify
programme.desc: Oneida Colombian-Canadian icon Lido Pimienta blends music, activism and hilarity in a candid look into her life and career. Featuring Tim Fontaine and Walking Eagle News in Cree, this episode explores humour as a force for survival.

programme.title: Dene Tribal Police Files
programme.desc: Dene, TsuutinaTsuutina police work with community members to ensure the health and well-being of the nations people and animals.For the tribal police, known as Tosguna since the 1800s,being part of this community means understanding its history.

programme.title: Dene Skindigenous

programme.title: Anishinaabemowin Crazy Like a Lynx

programme.title: Anishinaabemowin Acting Good
programme.desc: AnishinaabemowinPrincipal Sweetley gives Paul a second chance at finishing high school with a catch: a job shadowing assignment where he must go undercover for Constable Lips.Meanwhile, Jo vies for the prestigious Chiefy Award from Walking Eagle.

programme.title: Nisgaa Ocean Warriors: Mission Ready

programme.title: Nisgaa Ocean Warriors: Mission Ready
programme.desc: Nisgaa As the Kitkatla search and rescue unit uses their training to board an out-of-control tour boat and aid its incapacitated captain, children in the community strengthen their artistic skills through the lens of their culture and language.

programme.title: Kwakwala Ocean Warriors: Mission Ready

programme.title: Mikmaq Gespegewagi: The Last Land

programme.title: Mikmaq Spirit Talker

programme.title: Kanienkha Animal Nation
programme.desc: Kanienkha, Kanienkha Kahnawke and Six Nations Indigenous communities in Ontario and the Yukon reestablish their deep ties to the wolf by tracking and collaring, going on community hunts and bringing an ancient, fossilized pup to.
